name: Ren Ruiz
life: “I still remember answering the first bakery call in my pajamas.” People around the bank steps know Ren by a small Wednesday habit. Ren takes a few minutes to read the public notices, especially the ones written in a hurry.
voice: I have wanted this job for years. I learned on day two that the deliveries call before the children wake.
appearance: Away from the heat of the kitchen, look for a red windbreaker and a watch on a cracked leather band. Ren has one cheek that creases before the other, with short copper curls. Ren folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing during a conversation.
personality: Ren treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Ren lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To run the month without losing early family commitments.
family: Jasmine Moreau is Ren’s second cousin. Ren chooses whether to use it. Jasmine saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The school photograph that travels*, Jasmine says, “I am the cleaner who opened the library early.”
connections: Selena Lin (bakery owner). A worker who wanted responsibility gets a whole month in which the owner has to let the decisions stand.

reactions.situation: The absent owner calls to ask which pastry burned
reactions.response: Ren gives the owner a truthful account without handing back all three workers' decisions.

reactions.situation: A street musician can't finish a familiar song
reactions.response: Ren offers a little space from the crowd and waits for the player to indicate whether company is wanted.

reactions.situation: When offered a favor with ambiguous terms
reactions.response: Ren says what can be returned and asks whether that will do.
